get.summary: Agrochemists with the given status (pending by default), the longest waiting first

post.summary: approve (needs a document), reject or request_documents (both need a reason the agrochemist will see). Approving makes the agrochemist visible to farmers.

get.summary: The document as it was sent (PDF, JPEG or PNG), as a download

How the model performs over a period: the confidence of its answers, the classes it names most, the photos experts have decided (for retraining) and where the experts disagreed with the model. Class names are in the asked language. A diagnosis counts as decided when experts agree on one class; disputed and unclear ones do not count.

put.description: Gives or replaces the caller's verdict. 400 invalid_verdict (confirmed without an answer of the model, corrected to the model's own class, a class with unclear) or unknown_class; 404 diagnosis_not_found.

get.summary: All shops, hidden ones included, by name. search matches part of the name or the address. Region and district names are in the asked language.

post.summary: Adds a shop; it is active at once.

get.summary: Reports farmers sent, newest first; status filters them (the admin reads the new ones).

patch.summary: Marks a new report done or rejected. It does not change any shop: the admin adds or edits the shop with the calls above. A report is decided once (409 shop_request_resolved); 404 shop_request_not_found.

get.summary: Counters of the directory and of the reports.
One shop, hidden or not; 404 shop_not_found.

put.summary: Replaces the fields of a shop; its status is not changed here. 404 shop_not_found.

patch.summary: Hides a shop from farmers or shows it again. Repeating the current status is not an error. There is no delete.

get.summary: Farmers and agrochemists, newest first. search matches part of the name, the login (e-mail) or the phone digits. Administrators are not listed; phone and e-mail are not returned.

patch.summary: Blocks or unblocks a farmer or an agrochemist. A block takes effect at once: the access token is refused and every refresh token of the user is revoked; unblocking does not restore sessions, the user signs in again. The status of an administrator cannot be changed (403 admin_status_locked), nor can the caller's own. Repeating the current status is not an error.

get.description: The feed, newest first, without hidden questions. Filters (all optional): crop (up to 4, repeat the parameter), regionId, status open|solved|unanswered, mine. Pages: before = id of the last question of the previous page; an unknown id is 404 question_not_found.

post.description: Farmers only. Fields: title (3-120), text (1-2000), cropCode, optional diagnosisId (an own diagnosis of the same crop; 404 diagnosis_not_found, otherwise 400), photos (0-3 JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB each, 11 MB in all; the metadata is removed). The region comes from the profile: 400 region_required without one. 400 validation_failed or invalid_image; 413 payload_too_large; 429 rate_limited after 10 questions an hour; 503 storage_unavailable.

get.description: The diagnosis the author attached, for every reader; its photoUrl points to /api/community/questions/{id}/diagnosis/photo. 404 diagnosis_not_found without one.

post.description: The farmer asks a verified agrochemist. 409 consultation_already_open (Location points to it) or consultation_request_limit; 404 agrochemist_not_found or diagnosis_not_found.

get.description: Incoming unread messages in all consultations of the caller

post.description: Only from requested; 409 invalid_consultation_state (reason = current status) or agrochemist_not_listed.

Only from requested; 409 invalid_consultation_state (reason = current status).

404 consultation_not_found or diagnosis_not_found; 409 invalid_consultation_state before the consultation is accepted or after it was declined.

put.description: Gives or replaces the agrochemist's verdict on the attached diagnosis, in an active or closed consultation. 400 invalid_verdict or unknown_class; 404 consultation_not_found or diagnosis_not_found; 409 invalid_consultation_state.

get.description: Without a cursor or with before: the newest first, older than before. With after: the oldest first, newer than after. Not both. A cursor that is not a message of this consultation is 404 message_not_found.

post.description: Only in an active consultation: 409 invalid_consultation_state (reason = current status). 429 rate_limited after 30 messages a minute.

A JPEG or PNG photo of up to 10 MB with an optional text, in an active consultation. The type is taken from the first bytes, the metadata (GPS) is removed. 400 invalid_image (another type or a broken file); 413 payload_too_large (over 10 MB); 409 invalid_consultation_state; 429 rate_limited; 503 storage_unavailable.
Marks the incoming messages up to upTo (inclusive) as read; repeating it changes nothing. 404 message_not_found if upTo is not a message of this consultation.

parameters.description: One key per diagnosis the person wants to make (a UUID fits): the first request and every resend of it, after a lost answer or a timeout, carry the same key; a new diagnosis (another photo or crop) needs a new key. The key is tied to the crop and to the exact photo bytes (SHA-256): another crop or another photo under the same key is 422 idempotency_key_reused with reason crop or photo, so a retry must send the same file. A malformed key is 400 invalid_idempotency_key. A repeat does not spend the diagnosis rate limit. While the first request with the key is still being processed, another one gets 409 request_in_progress with Retry-After: 2 (seconds); the model is not called again and the limit is not spent.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

201.description: The diagnosis; for a repeated Idempotency-Key the one made the first time, with the header Idempotent-Replayed: true

409.description: request_in_progress: a request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed; repeat after the seconds in Retry-After

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before repeating the request

429.description: rate_limited: more than 20 attempts or more than 5 new diagnoses in a minute. Attempts are never given back; a diagnosis token is given back when the server failed (see docs/api/ai-predict.md). Repeat after the seconds in Retry-After

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the window of the limit ends

503.description: ai_unavailable: the AI service cannot be reached, is not ready, or runs a placeholder model; the app shows no model line then

get.summary: The version of the recognition model, as the AI service reports it (kept for about a minute)

post.description: Idempotent. Returns how many notifications are still unread.

put.description: Idempotent upsert by token. A token of another account moves to the caller. At most 10 devices per user: the least recently registered one is dropped.
